title: Implement confirmed external identity binding and failure atomicity
verify: Telegram and Google binding resolve to the invited account; a confirmed session is required for the second provider.
Provider outage or callback failure returns an explicit error with no partial identity state.
evidence_required: FT-001-AC-001 RED: a valid invitation flow does not bind the pre-created role-bearing account or rejects client role selection; GREEN: Telegram and Google each bind exactly the invitation account and retain role/membership; artifact: .tasks/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/ and .protocols/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/verification.md.

FT-001-AC-002 RED: adding the second provider succeeds without current-session reconfirmation or resolves to a different account; GREEN: reconfirmed session binds the other provider to the same account and unauthenticated add is rejected; artifact: .tasks/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/ and .protocols/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/verification.md.

FT-001-AC-004 RED: provider outage or callback failure leaves partial identity state or no explicit failure; GREEN: explicit failure is returned and persisted account/identity state is unchanged; artifact: .tasks/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/ and .protocols/TASK-004-T3-FT-001-W3/verification.md.
purpose: Complete external provider binding without weakening session confirmation or atomicity rules.
success_outcome: Both accepted providers can bind to the same account, second-provider addition rejects without re-confirmation, and failed callbacks leave no partial binding.
anti_goals: Do not trust provider responses in routes or UI without the boundary.
constraints: Provider adapters remain behind Identity & Access.
invariants: A provider identity is bound to at most one account.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-001: provider invitation integration for Telegram and Google, role-choice rejection, and cross-center denial with exact account/role/membership assertions.
FT-001-AC-002: Telegram/Google second-provider success and confirmed-session negative scenario proving both identities resolve to one account.
FT-001-AC-004: provider outage and failed-callback simulation with explicit error plus state-before/state-after persistence evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop if provider contract or accepted privacy boundary is materially unresolved.
